chunks: "Fulfillment is not achieved until it outweighs."

key_terms.آخَرَ: another; indicating a separate transmitted report
key_terms.الْوَفَاءُ: full and proper fulfillment, especially in giving due measure
key_terms.يَرْجَحَ: it outweighs; exceeds the exact amount slightly

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith teach about fairness and completeness in weighing and measuring?
ai.summary: This narration teaches that proper fulfillment in measured exchange is realized by giving slightly more rather than merely matching the exact amount. It reflects an ethic of honesty, fairness, and caution in commercial dealings.
